    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_rebels location:constantinople = { controller ?= c:BYZ.var:oe_vas_rebels } } add = -4 }  # 君士坦丁堡

    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_rebels location:silivri = { controller ?= c:BYZ.var:oe_vas_rebels } } add = -1 }  # 塞林布里亚
    else_if = { limit = { location:silivri = { controller ?= c:BYZ } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_rebels location:corlu = { controller ?= c:BYZ.var:oe_vas_rebels } } add = -1 }  # 乔尔卢
    else_if = { limit = { location:corlu = { controller ?= c:BYZ } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_rebels location:catalca = { controller ?= c:BYZ.var:oe_vas_rebels } } add = -1 }  # 梅特赖
    else_if = { limit = { location:catalca = { controller ?= c:BYZ } } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_rebels location:vize = { controller ?= c:BYZ.var:oe_vas_rebels } } add = -1 }  # 比齐耶
    else_if = { limit = { location:vize = { controller ?= c:BYZ } } add = 1 }
    divide = 2
}
